text:
- **Command-line code layout:** The command-line code now splits by noun. The leftover Python-port code is deleted, including the argument parser emulation.
- **Agent instructions:** AGENTS.md is now a short map, under the size cap, and every agent runtime reads it in full. A size test and an agent evaluation run in CI on every pull request.
- **Test and CI speed:** Docs-only pull requests now skip the Go test matrix and pass merge-ready. Median check time is still above the target.
- **Sprint close rule:** A sprint close now checks only the covers patterns it added or changed while open. Another session's older pending pattern no longer blocks the close.
